about: Prologue sound effects (plan 5.2), generated with ElevenLabs sound generation by tools/sfx/generate.py into game/assets/story/sfx/<id>.ogg. seconds: requested length (0.5-30). loop: seamless ambience loop (ElevenLabs loop mode plus an equal-power crossfade of the ends). gain: dB relative to the reference loudness (loops -24 LUFS like the rain, one-shots -18 LUFS). stereo: keep two channels (default: loops yes, one-shots no, since one-shots play in 3D). influence: prompt_influence 0..1 (default 0.5).
